summary.headline: Regency Fincorp Q1 FY27: PAT of INR7.0 crore on total income of INR17.4 crore (+86% YoY); AUM INR345 crore; blended cost of funds 13.25%.
summary.overview: Regency Fincorp reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR17.4 crore (+86% YoY), PBT of INR9.4 crore and PAT of INR7.0 crore, with AUM rising to INR345 crore from INR261 crore at March 2026. Secured loan book grew to INR230 crore from INR159 crore, and unsecured share fell from 26% to 18%. Management said the blended borrowing cost is 13.25% and expects it to fall toward 12.75-12.95% by end-Q2 and 11.75-12.5% by year-end. Management reiterated FY27 targets of revenue above INR75 crore and PAT of INR25-30 crore, and AUM of INR500-550 crore by year-end.

financial_highlights.change: +44% from INR159 crore at Mar 2026; ~5x YoY

segments.name: Secured MSME lending
segments.commentary: Secured loan book INR230 crore at June 2026, up 44% from INR159 crore in March 2026. Yield on MSME deployments about 21-22%, net borrowing about 13.5%, opex about 2-2.25%, credit cost about 1%, spread about 3.4-3.5%.

segments.name: Digital lending (Cash My Salary)
segments.commentary: Digital portfolio about INR23 crore since launch, roughly 6-7% of AUM. Average tenor about 4 months, flat ~30% interest plus 5-7% processing fee, APR about 89% per management. Management reported 95-96% collection in month 0-1 across two cycles.

guidance_outlook: FY27 total revenue guided at upwards of INR75 crore (management calls this conservative); Q2-Q4 expected to exceed Q1.
FY27 PAT guided at INR25-30 crore.
AUM target of INR500-550 crore by end of FY27.
Blended cost of borrowing expected near 12.75-12.95% by end of Q2 FY27 and 11.75-12.5% by year-end; target to bring lending rates down to 11.5-12%.
Gross NPA to stay within 1-1.25% and net NPA at or below about 1%; credit cost below 1%.
Planned private placement of NCDs of INR50-75 crore in Q2 FY27 (board approved); proceeds to MSME secured and digital lending books.
Target to become a small finance bank by FY30; no deposit-taking until then.
Leverage target 3.5x-4x debt-to-net-owned-funds; management cited AUM target INR3,000 crore by FY30 in a question.
capex_capacity: Presence in five states (Punjab, Haryana, parts of Uttarakhand, eastern UP, Chandigarh base); board cap of 20% of portfolio in any state.
Branch AUM cap of INR12 crore for MSME secured (INR15 crore in Ludhiana); 20+ branches serving 16,000+ customers.
Digital pin code coverage about 11,000 today, targeted to rise to about 18,000 in the coming year.
Tech and digital team of 50+ members at Noida office; corporate office shifted to Delhi/Noida.
PPI license approved; expected to be operational in about 3-5 months.
demand_pricing: Secured MSME lending focused on Tier 2 cities; excludes trading, realty, livestock, agri and services; collateral is self-occupied built-up residential/commercial property at about 50% LTV; minimum 3-year business vintage.
Management targets MSME secured yield of 15-17% over time versus about 21-22% today, passing lower borrowing costs to customers.
Digital borrowers are salaried employees of corporates or LLPs with at least 6 months of salary credits; 70% fresh and 30% repeat customers.
Management sees organised salaried borrower universe of INR50,000-60,000 crore, and says competition is less intense in Tier 2 unorganised segments.
Cost-of-funds update: NCDs at 13% in Q1, plus a INR10 crore bank line at 10.35%; new banks guided at 10.75-11%.

qa_highlights.question: Why are recent NCDs at 14% when incremental cost of funds was guided to lower double digit?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said an NCD mandate signed earlier was at 14%, with later issuance at 13%; blended cost is 13.25%, targeted to fall to 12.75-12.95% by end-Q2 and 11.75-12.5% by year-end.

qa_highlights.question: What is the sectoral exposure of the secured MSME book?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the book is mainly retail manufacturers and suppliers (hardware, small manufacturing, beverage/pulp sub-segments); trading, realty, livestock, agri and services are excluded.

qa_highlights.question: What are FY27 bottom-line and NNPA expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided FY27 revenue above INR75 crore and PAT of INR25-30 crore, with gross NPA not exceeding 1-1.25% and net NPA around 1%; it declined to give quarterly PAT guidance beyond calling Q1 numbers conservative.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company fund growth to INR1,500-2,000 crore AUM?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will keep borrowings at 3.5x-4x net owned funds, so INR200 crore net worth supports about INR750-800 crore debt and about INR1,000 crore AUM, with further equity via internal accruals or preferential issues.

qa_highlights.question: How is digital customer acquisition done and at what cost?
qa_highlights.answer: Acquisition relies on digital ads, referrals and RM-generated leads; management cited about 4% opex plus acquisition spend on digital book and said initial tech set-up is largely complete.

qa_highlights.question: Can the company replicate auditor and governance stability?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Monika Garg is the current auditor and that any future change would be to a larger firm.

qa_highlights.question: What is the promoter holding outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to elaborate on the call and offered a one-to-one discussion, saying promoter holding is higher than the 24-25% that appears.

risks_watch: Concentration in Tier 2 Northern India markets; dependence on branch and state caps.
Digital unsecured book (about 20% of target mix) has short history of two cycles; NPA behaviour at scale is untested.
Cost-of-funds reduction depends on new bank lines (10.75-11%) and NCD pricing; NCDs were still raised at 13-14%.
Guidance implies sharp PAT step-up (INR25-30 crore vs INR7 crore in Q1); management did not provide quarterly path.
Auditor changes and promoter holding clarity were raised as governance points; management deferred promoter holding details to one-to-one.
Pending PPI licence and digital pin code expansion to 18,000 are dependencies for growth.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on growth, digital strategy and cost-of-funds reduction, but evasive on promoter holding (deferred to one-to-one) and on quarterly profit outlook beyond calling the numbers conservative. Several answers were long and repetitive, and some figures (NNPA 0.74% vs 0.76%, digital share 6% vs 20% target) were inconsistent across the call.
key_quotes: We are not wanting being at a 23%, 24%. Our desire is 15%, 16%, 17%, okay?
We are not funding any thing which is related to livestock, whether it is a poultry, whether it is an animal husbandry onto it.

Our medium-term objective is very clear, that is to scale AUM towards INR500 to INR550 crores by the end of this fiscal year while maintaining strong asset quality, capital adequacy and governance standards.

adds.what: PPI license (payments) operational in about 3-5 months
Digital pin code coverage expanding from ~11,000 to ~18,000 in the coming year

growth.why: Management guides FY27 total revenue above INR75 crore (vs Q1 total income INR17.4 cr, +86% YoY) and PAT INR25-30 crore, with AUM targeted at INR500-550 crore from INR345 crore; backing is partial (AUM growth from secured book up 44% QoQ, NCD placement of INR50-75 crore planned Q2, PPI license and pin-code expansion) but no specific new capacity or contracted orders with numbers.
